newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse closes 0.77 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse closes 0.77 pct higher.

text.p: Casablanca stock exchange closed on Monday 0.77 percent higher boosted by gains in most stocks traded, notably ONA group and Societe Nationale d'Investissement, stockbrokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 645.13 points from 640.21 on Thursday. Friday was a public holiday.
ONA, the biggest Moroccan private conglomerate, gained 20 dirhams to 815 dirhams.
SNI, the second largest private group, rose 10 dirhams to 740 dirhams.
In the banking sector, Wafabank advanced 16 dirhams to 840 dirhams. Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur closed unchanged at 580 dirhams.
Blue-chip Banque Commerciale du Maroc was up five dirhams to 865 dirhams.
In the energy sector, Samir increased by five dirhams to 356 dirhams. Mining firm Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter rose 15 dirhams to 576 dirhams.
First tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in January 1996, fell 10 dirhams to 1,360 dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 16.6 million dirhams from 27.6 million dirhams.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was 33.6 million from 30.5 million dirhams.
